About Around Notes - HIPAA-Safe AI Medical Documentation Platform

# About Around Notes 

 Around Notes is an AI-powered inpatient documentation platform built by a hospitalist, for hospitalists — and the inpatient specialists, surgeons, residents, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants working alongside them. We're a California-based company, founded and operated in the United States. 

 We're not a startup born in a boardroom. We're not backed by venture capital or beholden to investors chasing the next funding round. We're a small, focused team building a product that solves a real clinical problem — because our founder lives it every day. 

 Dr. Micheal Massoud, DO 

 Practicing Hospitalist · Founder · ACOI 

## Where This Came From 

 Dr. Micheal Massoud is a practicing hospitalist and the founder and CEO of Spyglass Systems LLC, a California company registered in Yolo County. He didn't start Around Notes to build a company — he started it because he was tired of finishing a long day of rounding only to face a stack of notes still waiting to be written. 

 EMRs were designed for billing, not for clinicians. Documentation became a burden layered on top of an already demanding job. Around Notes came from that frustration: a better way to turn chart context and clinical thinking into a complete, paste-ready note — faster, cleaner, and with a built-in second pass to catch what tired eyes miss.
